request.style: English, ancient Middle Eastern dance song, a women's chorus led by a strong female voice, frame drums and darbuka, oud, ney flute, ululation and handclaps, Phrygian dominant scale, 6/8, 132 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Miriam took the tambourine
All the women followed her
Dancing on the farther shore
Where the sea had closed once more

[Chorus]
Sing to the Lord, for he is highly exalted
Horse and rider he has hurled into the sea
Sing to the Lord, for he is highly exalted
Horse and rider he has hurled into the sea

[Verse]
The Lord is my strength and my song
He has become my salvation
He is my God and I will praise him
My father's God, I will exalt him

[Chorus]
Sing to the Lord, for he is highly exalted
Horse and rider he has hurled into the sea
Sing to the Lord, for he is highly exalted
Horse and rider he has hurled into the sea
